items: 【Efficient Performance】 Powered by an Intel Celeron N4500 dual-core processor with speeds up to 2.8GHz, suitable for everyday tasks and multitasking on Windows 11 Home.
【15.6" Anti-Glare Display】 Enjoy clear visuals on the HD (1366x768) display with 220 nits brightness, ideal for reducing eye strain in various lighting.
【Generous Memory & Storage】 Equipped with upgraded DDR4 RAM for smooth multitasking and a 640GB SSD for fast boot times and ample file storage.
【Connectivity & Privacy】 Features Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2 for fast wireless connections, plus an HD webcam with a privacy shutter for added security.
【Lightweight & Long Battery Life】 Weighing only 3.42 lbs with a sleek Celestial Azure design, this laptop offers up to 10 hours of battery life, making it highly portable.
